401-2530-3944-6094.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2530-3944-6094.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

2645-2872-3230-3430.description:

Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4316-5078-5223-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3769-5571-6495--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Blim to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
3769-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3129-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating six 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Ojer Taq and Primal Vigor.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1270-3129-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 7^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 42 after the first iteration, 294 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

215-1115-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1418-2908-3821.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
1418-2908-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1652-4668-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1652-4668-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

679-2894-4389-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Grave-Shell Scarab. Then, the draw will be replaced by Grave-Shell Scarab's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Grave-Shell Scarab from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1115-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-1115-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

486-1978-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
486-1978-5168.description:
Cause Bloom Tender to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least three mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Peregrine Drake
When Shipwreck Dowser and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3647-3821-4125.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

431-1744-6441.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating twice that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

437-3525-3755.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

618-997-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2438-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
2438-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-5627-6529.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5627-6529.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-5627-6529.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-4544-5256--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4544-5256--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4544-5256--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Mandibular Kite from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mandibular Kite enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Phyrexian Germ creature token and attaching Mandibular Kite to it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Mandibular Kite.
The Phyrexian Germ dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

2100-2633-6259.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Urabrask triggers, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve Searing Touch.
Repeat.

You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.

1636-4147-4215-5686.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1
Repeat.

Thornbite Staff attached to Warchanter Skald.
An additional creature on the battlefield that will die when dealt 1 damage.
